question: Should Discord ship this opt-in source-message subagent progress contract, including the new configuration and plugin lifecycle surface, or should subagent visibility be folded into the existing shared progress and status-reaction system instead?
rationale: The patch is well-proven and has no remaining discrete correctness finding, but code evidence cannot decide whether the permanent product contract should be a Discord-specific tracker with seven settings and new SDK metadata or an extension of shared channel progress ownership.

options.title: Sponsor the scoped feature
options.body: Approve the Discord-owned design, then require a clean current-main rebase plus fresh upgrade and live Discord proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow into shared progress
options.body: Request a smaller redesign that reuses generic status and progress ownership and avoids parallel lifecycle or configuration surfaces where possible.

options.title: Decline the surface
options.body: Close the proposal if the passive count and failure-reaction UX is not worth the additional long-term configuration and SDK contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the scoped feature
recommendation.body: Approve the Discord-owned design, then require a clean current-main rebase plus fresh upgrade and live Discord proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision primarily governs Discord UX, reaction ownership, typing behavior, and Discord configuration policy.
